source.name: test262
fetch: git -C corpus-cache/d2/test262 sparse-checkout set harness test/language test/built-ins

selection.stratum: top-level directory under test/language or test/built-ins
selection.quota_weight: eligible_pool_size ** 0.65, largest remainder, capped at pool size
selection.pick: evenly spaced over the sorted pool: index (2i+1)*n // (2k)
selection.harness_order: assert.js, sta.js, doneprintHandle.js (flags: async), includes in frontmatter order; none for flags: raw
selection.module_tests: kept only if the file has a static import/export and every specifier is './<file>.js' in the same directory; imported fixtures are inputs in dependency post-order before the test file
selection.strictness: --strict_mode_input=false for flags noStrict or raw; default (strict) otherwise
